notes: The nine House Moves items of the Redevelopment Agency Records, SFH371-5087 to SFH371-5095 (Buchanan, Octavia, Turk and Webster Streets, Victorian Square, and three 'Unidentified'), read page by page from 100-dpi page images. Nearly all of the 438 pages are photographs of Western Addition houses on dollies, with the photographer's stamp and a negative or roll-and-frame number on the back. Only four captions name a street address. People in the photographs and named residents are not transcribed.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in these nine items. The collection's Parcel Appraisal Reports (SFH371-5039 to 5048), conservation study (5000), appraisal volumes (5001 to 5038) and Yerba Buena block files (5055 to 5078) are unread.
coverage.note: Captioned with an address: 5087 p. 4 (1838 Buchanan to 1440 Post), 5089 pp. 9-13 (773 Turk to 1735-37 Webster), 5090 p. 17 (Hollis at Webster, 1421-27) and 5094 p. 88 (1331-35 Scott). Not findings: 5094 pp. 60-86, fourteen print backs pencilled with a 1970s block and lot only (766/4, 5, 10, 12, 13, 14, 31; 767/5, 6, 9, 10, 15, 18; one illegible), with no street number and no direction of move; and every print carrying only a negative or roll-frame number (5088, 5091, 5092, 5093, 5095).

resolution.method: Recorded range 1331-1335 SCOTT ST; EAS matches 1331, 1333, 1335 on this street → parcel 1100120; sf-parcels has blklot 1100120 active, 1331–1331 SCOTT; the 2025 roll records it as single family residential, built 1900. EAS puts 1331, 1333, 1335 SCOTT ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 1331. Parcel 1100120 is one unit of a condominium (the 2025 roll classes this parcel as a Condominium with zero lot area, which is a unit and not a building); the fact is the building's, and goes on the building's page at this path, which lists its units (#228). The recorded numbers are on 3 parcels today (1100120 (1331), 1100121 (1333), 1100122 (1335)); sf-parcels files all of them under one map lot, 1100120, and the roll classes them as condominiums, so they are the units of one building and the range is that building's.
